description.value: Choose one installed augment and raise it permanently to Grade 5, whatever your level. You gain the Construct trait in addition to your own, placing you on the Cybernetics side of the setting’s system matchup: flesh-mancy corrupts and overrides you more easily, and Spirit-Faith effects — possession, soul-based debuffs — find less of you to hold. This is a permanent change to what you are, and no augment removal undoes it.

value.value: Overclock Augment, and Drift at your highest permanent threshold

cinderfall.incomplete: Permanently raising an installed augment to Grade 5 is a change to Cinderfall's own Grade/slot bookkeeping, which has no representation in the actor schema. Gaining the Construct trait has no confirmed rule-element hook: no 'add a trait to the actor' rule element was found anywhere in the compendium (traits are normally fixed at build time per ancestry/class, not granted by a feat), so adding it here would be unverified rather than confirmed.
